subsystems.name: Build system & toolchain
subsystems.notes: clang i686 + SDL3, ninja, one command

subsystems.name: Asset pipeline (ROM symbols)
subsystems.notes: 61k symbols pinned to the ROM, 47 native relocations

subsystems.name: GBA memory map & ROM loading
subsystems.notes: address space embedded in the PE image; NULL and out-of-range accesses emulate the GBA bus (port_biosfault.c)

subsystems.name: BIOS services
subsystems.notes: CpuSet, CpuFastSet, LZ77, BgAffineSet, Sqrt, reset

subsystems.name: DMA controller
subsystems.notes: immediate, VBlank, HBlank with register latching

subsystems.name: Interrupts & frame timing
subsystems.notes: exact 59.7275 Hz pacing, one game update per VBlank (verified against BizHawk); FPS and logic-rate readout

subsystems.name: PPU renderer
subsystems.notes: modes 0-5, affine, windows, blending, mosaic, OBJ window; HUD layer follows GBA priorities (message windows stay in front)

subsystems.name: Input (keyboard / gamepad)
subsystems.notes: default bindings; one-button dodge roll and stock (L+R); remapping pending

subsystems.name: m4a sequencer & mixer
subsystems.notes: full C port of m4a_1.s, 4x oversampled mixing

subsystems.name: PSG (CGB) channels
subsystems.notes: square+sweep, wave, noise, envelopes, NR52

subsystems.name: PCM streaming (FIFO)
subsystems.notes: timer 0 + DMA1/2 streams

subsystems.name: Block audio codec transform
subsystems.notes: transform.s in C

subsystems.name: Movie (FMV) decoder
subsystems.notes: native C; all 3605 video frames and 3604 audio blocks match ARM; all five movies play to their last frame and hand over to the next scene (castle, Larxene, Destiny Islands, staff roll) — KHCOM_MOVIE

subsystems.name: Save data (SRAM)
subsystems.notes: kh_com.sav (per version) next to the exe, atomic writes; quick save, restart and load verified

subsystems.name: Soft reset
subsystems.notes: A+B+Select+Start returns to the language select; game globals restored from a snapshot

subsystems.name: Widescreen: renderer
subsystems.notes: world-map extension for map-block BGs, full-range sprite positions, per-scene validation

subsystems.name: Widescreen: field maps
subsystems.notes: map-block rooms and cell-built rooms extend with the game's own composition; void beyond the world is black

subsystems.name: Widescreen: battles
subsystems.notes: affine arenas extend; HUD on its own scaled layer anchored to the corners; tutorial pointers follow the HUD; battle messages docked

subsystems.name: Widescreen: menus & events
subsystems.notes: menus on their own layer at the window's height, anchored to both edges (pause, save, world select, level up); battle start fills the height; sub-menus pending

subsystems.name: Graphics options menu
subsystems.notes: overlay with the game font, 5 languages, live changes; HUD size, HD text, control options; opened from title (SELECT), F1/Esc, Back+Start

subsystems.name: Gameplay verification
subsystems.notes: all 194 story events start from the debug event menu and run hidden (port/tools/test_events.py); Spanish opening, first battle and reload verified; stray pointers and x/0 behave as on the GBA bus

subsystems.name: Save states
subsystems.notes: F5/F9, slots F6/F7; SRAM excluded; validated per build

subsystems.name: HD text
subsystems.notes: dialogue and battle messages drawn with an outline font at output resolution; menus and Japanese text pending

subsystems.name: USA and Japanese versions
subsystems.notes: separate builds (configure --version us|jp); boot, opening movie and first scene verified; own save files; HD text and options overlay in English only

subsystems.name: Launcher & ROM install
subsystems.notes: decompui (Dear ImGui): installs any of the three dumps by SHA-1, settings, enhancements, controls, starts the matching game; packaging updated

subsystems.name: Skip intro
subsystems.notes: A shows a prompt in the game's font with an A button; A again skips the opening

milestones.name: All 269 game units compile for x86
